body.name: P^\star
body.construction:
Take \(N_0=T_0=J=r=2\) and
\[
M=\begin{pmatrix}4/5&3/5\\3/5&3/10\end{pmatrix},\qquad
y=(7/10,9/20),\qquad
B=\begin{pmatrix}7/10&2/5\\1/2&1/5\end{pmatrix},\qquad
s_1=(7/10,2/5).
\]
The target-pre pair \(y\), the two donor-pre rows of \(M\), and the two donor-post rows of \(B\) are the five observed untreated event-survival pairs.  In each of those five cells, interpret the observed event time \(T_{ci}\) as the untreated potential event time.  In the target factual-post cell, write \(T^{1}_{\mathrm{post},i}\) for the treated potential event time, impose consistency \(T_{ci}=T^{1}_{\mathrm{post},i}\), and give \(T^{1}_{\mathrm{post},i}\) the observed marginal survival pair \(s_1\).  Put
\[
\theta^0:=yM^{-1}B=(3/5,3/10)
\]
and introduce an untreated target-post potential event time \(T^{0}_{\mathrm{post},i}\).

In every cell let \(X_{ci}\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\).  For each of the five non-target-post cells with displayed pair \((a,b)\), and for \(T^{1}_{\mathrm{post},i}\) with \((a,b)=s_1\), put \(\epsilon_x=2x-1\) and assign, conditional on \(X_{ci}=x\),
\[
\begin{aligned}
P_c(T=t_{c1}\mid X_{ci}=x)&=1-a-\epsilon_x/20,\\
P_c(T=t_{c2}\mid X_{ci}=x)&=a-b+\epsilon_x/40,\\
P_c(T=\infty\mid X_{ci}=x)&=b+\epsilon_x/40,
\end{aligned}
\]
where \(T\) denotes the relevant observed event time in a non-target-post cell and denotes \(T^{1}_{\mathrm{post},i}\) in the target factual-post cell.  Assign \(T^{0}_{\mathrm{post},i}\) by the same three-atom formula with \((a,b)=\theta^0\).

Set \((\gamma_{10},\gamma_{20})=(4/5,1/2)\) and \((\gamma_{11},\gamma_{21})=(3/5,2/5)\), and in every cell assign
\[
\begin{aligned}
P_c(C_{ci}=t_{c1}\mid X_{ci}=x)&=1-\gamma_{1x},\\
P_c(C_{ci}=t_{c2}\mid X_{ci}=x)&=\gamma_{1x}-\gamma_{2x},\\
P_c(C_{ci}=\infty\mid X_{ci}=x)&=\gamma_{2x}.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus
\[
\bigl(P_c(C_{ci}>t_{c1}\mid X_{ci}=x),
P_c(C_{ci}>t_{c2}\mid X_{ci}=x)\bigr)
=(\gamma_{1x},\gamma_{2x}).
\]
Conditional on \(X_{ci}\), draw the observed untreated event time and \(C_{ci}\) independently in each of the five non-target-post cells.  In the target factual-post cell, draw \(T^{0}_{\mathrm{post},i}\), \(T^{1}_{\mathrm{post},i}\), and \(C_{ci}\) mutually independently conditional on \(X_{ci}\).  In every observed cell set \(U_{ci}=\min(T_{ci},C_{ci})\) and \(\Delta_{ci}=\mathbf 1\{T_{ci}\le C_{ci}\}\).  Take \(P^\star\) to be the product across the six cells of these full-data laws, including both target-post potential event times.
